=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:~1405,~1414,~1424,~1476 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: None of the four post-provenance `exit 0` sites sets `VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON`, so the EXIT trap posts `unspecified` with `outcome=skipped`.
  WHY: The reason is not diagnosable from the comment, although the log lines already name it. Routing is not broken.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:`_validation_route_post` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_ROUTE_POSTED=true` is set before the single-attempt comment POST. On failure the EXIT trap does not retry or post a skipped marker.
  WHY: A transient API error leaves the tracking issue without the marker. The failure is logged only as `comment=failed`, with no workflow warning.
- Hardening 1: set `VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON` at the four exits (4 lines).
- Hardening 2: emit `::warning::WORKFLOW_HEAL validation_route_comment_failed fp=${VALIDATION_ROUTE_FP} source=${SOURCE_LABEL}` on a failed POST (2 lines).
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1114-1124 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_validation_route_post` sets `VALIDATION_ROUTE_POSTED=true` before the marker POST succeeds.
  WHY: If the API call fails, the EXIT trap skips the fallback `skipped` marker, so the issue has no marker comment.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1405,1414,1424,1476 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The exit sites for API fetch failures and empty run sets do not set `VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON`.
  WHY: The fallback reason defaults to `unspecified`, which makes debugging difficult.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1402,1411,1418,1472 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The four post-provenance `exit 0` sites, newly extended to `validation_failure`, do not assign `VALIDATION_ROUTE_SKIP_REASON`, which `_validation_route_exit` (:1152) falls back to `unspecified`.
  WHY: The consumer cannot distinguish an unreadable jobs API from a run with no failed job. Routing is unaffected.
- Hardening 1: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1972 calls `_compose_payload_file` unguarded in the duplicate branch, while `_open_issue` (:2749) falls back to `${PAYLOAD_FILE}`. A failure would abort the run under `set -e` and lose the occurrence comment. Fix: `local cf; cf="$(_compose_payload_file)" || cf="${PAYLOAD_FILE}"`.
- Hardening 2: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1121-1123 — emit `::warning::WORKFLOW_HEAL validation_route_comment_failed source=${SOURCE_LABEL} fp=${VALIDATION_ROUTE_FP}` when the comment state is not `posted`.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_phase_report.sh:185-190; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:410-442; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:799-803 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The validate reporter dispatches even without an OIDC identity. The intake accepts unauthenticated reports by default, and provenance for validation_failure checks only the run, jobs, workflow path and tracking issue number.
  WHY: A caller with the consumer GH_PAT can submit a fabricated payload that references a genuine failed run. With REPORT_AUTH=absent the intake accepts it, and the fabricated fields drive deduplication and heal routing.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1114,1121-1124,1151 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_validation_route_post` sets `VALIDATION_ROUTE_POSTED=true` before the comment POST succeeds, so a failed POST makes the EXIT trap skip another routing comment.
  WHY: gh_retry makes only one attempt on the non-idempotent POST. The tracking issue is left without the marker, so the poller cannot apply its heal-issue state checks.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish a jobs-API failure from a run with no failed job. This affects diagnosis, not routing.
- Hardening 1: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, `_validation_route_post` (~line 1124) — emit `::warning::WORKFLOW_HEAL validation_route_comment_failed source=${SOURCE_LABEL} fp=${VALIDATION_ROUTE_FP}` on a failed POST (2 lines, risk 2).
